note: The leaf heads the section 'Περὶ τῆς τρίτης κλίσεως' ('Ἡ τρίτη κλίσις'), but Y reads 'πέμπτης' twice and also gives 'σπετειούς' for 'ἐρετριεύς'.
The leaf is p. 517 'IOANNIS PRIMA' ('ut gaudium uestrum sit plenum'); X transcribes a different leaf (Apocalypse, p. 542).
The leaf is p. 90 'LOCA MANIFESTE DEPRAVATA'; Y gives another leaf (p. 91 'AD PLACANDOS ...').
The leaf is p. 55 Matthew 24 ('dicabitur hoc euangelium regni'); Y gives Gethsemane text from p. 362, which is another leaf.
The image prints 'uertit aũt σ in ξ', 'per ᾱος, per εως', 'abiectionẽ σ' and 'και coniunctionẽ'; X turns these into 'o in epsilon' and 'per os, per eos', and drops σ and και.

The errors are small and split between the two: X has the leaf's 'infectum', 'acerbius' and 'percutito... effundet' but miscites note 96 as 'Matth. Ⅷ' (leaf: xviii) and note 3 as 'Exod. Ⅳ' (leaf: iii); Y has the right citations but 'acertius' and 'percutit... effundit'.
The leaf reads 'treis hypostaseis confitentes', which Y gives as 'consistentes'; otherwise both are close, with X expanding the abbreviations.
The leaf reads 'ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦ' and 'ἀρχὴ παντὸς'; X has 'ἐκ τῶν καλοῦ' and 'ἀρχὴ πάντων', which are minor slips.

Y's first lines are garbled ('τα βροτων ἧμαρ ἔλοι αὐτοὺς τὸ ἴσον μοιρᾷ σᾶς'), where the leaf reads 'ἐρωτῶν εἰ ἀφέλοι αὐτῆς τοὺς κυνοραιστάς', though Y has the later 'πόσα μὲν οὖν εἴδη παραδειγμάτων' right.
The leaf reads 'κατὰ τὸ δοκοῦν εὐφημότερον' and 'ἐπὶ τοῖς ὀρθῶς'; X gives 'δύσφημον' (the opposite sense) and 'ἀλλὰ τοῖς ὀρθῶς', and adds an invented '2 Sam. 1:26' margin note.
